body:
FND-07 exact source delivery is executing in [PR #70](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/pull/70), implementation head `936e37d6be25decc89ceb3d4b8c1be60c61de9ed`. Before any source upload, the [required dated modification/source-availability companion and original notices](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-platform/blob/936e37d6be25decc89ceb3d4b8c1be60c61de9ed/plan/verification/source-ref-promotion/publication-rights.md) were published and verified anonymously byte-for-byte at that immutable platform commit (20 companion/notice/evidence files). That companion accompanies each delivery linked below, preserves original grants and gives the exact public MPL sources for inherited Web-IFC executable assets.

The authorized guarded helper will disable and read back repository Actions, then create these exact refs only if still absent; these are planned endpoints, not yet a success claim:

- [aloerch/ambisgis-postgresql](https://github.com/aloerch/ambisgis-postgresql/tree/ambisgis/review/fnd-07-baseline-v4): `2ff1375b5dd8bf09d8cb0e795974528180fd75ca`.

QGIS and GeoTools remain held for the precise conditions in the companion. No held source is uploaded, no default/canonical ref changes, and no task acceptance is inferred. Actual after-state, fresh owned-remote recovery and unchanged zero-mutation replay receipts will follow in the same PR. FND-02 stays accepted; FND-07 stays open; FND-08 stays unaccepted.
